headline: Ukrainian drones strike Yandex data center used for AI supercomputers
summary: Ukrainian drones struck a Yandex data center in Sasovo, Russia, that housed supercomputers used to train Yandex's AI model. Outlets report the Nvidia-powered systems were damaged, and Yandex says restoring the affected cloud region to operation may not be possible.
